# R000B weather-consumer withdrawal implementation plan

**Goal:** Remove expired weather influence from every affected cloud publication when the prayer timetable is unavailable, preserving existing weather policy and independent celestial rendering.

**Baseline:** `eebba178172f96b3ffe5ab3845bc0fffd57c6e1b`, tree `6b94a3933f9d1381b1c2ceaab287c93afb215ecb`. This is the isolated `pro/r000b-explicit-weather-withdrawal-20261106` worktree. The owner explicitly commissioned parallel preparation alongside R0017/R0007; integration requires fresh shared-hunk reconciliation and exact owner merge approval.

**Spec:** [issue #11 corrective amendment](https://github.com/theislampill/salah_widget/issues/11#issuecomment-6700189703) and completion-v2 commission. Preserve the original B01–B18 acceptance evidence; requalify affected caller/consumer paths and all fifteen ES0B criteria. Full local obligation reconciliation is retained in the execution run and will accompany the candidate.

## Scope and preserved contracts

Authored changes may touch `src/native/index.html`, the demonstrated foreground boundary in `real-sky/native-host-hooks.js`, `real-sky/native-composition.mjs`, and final foreground publication guards in `real-sky/native-host.mjs` / `real-sky/native-preview-host.mjs` only if needed to reject a capture invalidated during asynchronous mask decode. Add focused tests, a bounded native fixture/driver, a qualification workflow if required by host capability, and source-linked documentation. Regenerate outputs only with `python tools/build_native.py`; run `python tools/verify_v1.py`.

Keep source/retrieval TTLs and zero future allowance, admission/attempt ownership, current-model versus observation/SIM/ADVANCING policy, provider/retry logic, cloud geometry/lighting/motion math, independent Sun/Moon/catalogue, and frozen V1/vendor science unchanged. No new clock, timer, render loop, generalized state framework, or production deployment configuration.

## Observed failure and design

The actual admitted cloudy record survives same-target midnight. At 900 seconds the missing-prayer branch retains its established deck; at 901 seconds the weather selector and header become unavailable while readiness, coverage, density and painter fills remain. The ordinary full-model withdrawal works. A separate actual-loop schedule shows expiry between the one-second render and a 77 ms cloud-painter opportunity. Foreground composition also captures the native canvas independently of that loop.

Use one narrow weather-consumer publication record as a receipt of consumed authority, not another eligibility flag. It binds the admitted record, target/generation, mode and explicit publication state. Existing `weatherDecision` remains the sole freshness/effect authority. Share a single withdrawal operation that clears targets/coverage/readiness, density and backing raster while retaining raw provenance, population and accumulated motion.

Warm no-prayer policy: an already published deck may remain only while its actual record/target is current. Cold or previously withdrawn no-prayer state stays empty. A replacement record cannot attach fresh permission to the old deck: without a complete atmosphere it is conservatively withheld until normal full publication. This is an explicit consumer policy; no fabricated prayer model is permitted.

Reconcile before each cloud paint and each foreground capture, using the existing decision. Fence asynchronous foreground publication against the captured cloud authority so later callbacks cannot restore withdrawn pixels. A narrow host hook may expose reconciliation/currentness; keep numerical scientific inputs and transforms unchanged. The no-prayer render passes its captured decision into the independent celestial path. Withdraw dependent cloud/weather overlays and physical particle permissions when unavailable, preserving physical bodies and their independent evidence.

Diagnostics must distinguish the current candidate from the last consumed publication, report actual cloud coverage/readiness and actual displayed particle state, and never manufacture zero cloud coverage by calling `atmosphere(null)`.

Publish a coherent own-branch candidate with non-closing `Implements #11`, read it back, and request only the remaining exact head/base/tree merge decision. Then the same thread performs approved merge, required delivery verification, certificate/readback and deliberate issue closure/readback.

## Review focus

- Raster, column density, solar masks and decoded pending foreground can outlive zeroed numeric state.
- A new record with identical weather values still must not acquire a withdrawn old publication accidentally.
- Authority can expire between UI render and a foreground capture; diagnostics must not repair it as a side effect.
- Hidden/reduced motion must clear on the first eligible visible publication without a backlog or new loop.
- Same-target withdrawal/recovery must preserve cloud population and motion phase; scientific celestial output remains independently useful.

## Stop and recovery conditions

Use the supported Andon diagnosis/countermeasure/verification loop for a changed protected source, failed native instrument, generated mismatch, contradictory pixels or stale owner identity. Do not waive required visual proof because local process launch fails. Hosted qualification is permissible only on this isolated branch with explicit ref/hash fences, ephemeral resources and no deployment or other-owner writes. An unavailable external capability leaves that gate open while all safe executable work continues.

## Rollback and terminal boundary

Revert the bounded source and corresponding generated output together if healthy behavior regresses. Preserve conservative unavailable behavior, raw cache bytes and all failure evidence. No success is claimed by this plan. Engineering, review, owner approval, merge, delivery, certificate and CLOSED/completed are separate gates.
